title: Mourning the Fallen Player
description: A man in a black suit stands solemnly beside a wooden coffin draped in blue and white cloth, his hands bloodied. Behind him, a torn wall reveals a nighttime soccer field where a match continues under floodlights, while mourners and a figure holding a baby observe from the shadows of a candlelit archway.
